lessonTitle: Acts Chapter 12 — Peter’s Miraculous Escape From Prison

questions.questionText: I arrested some who belonged to the church, intending to persecute them. Who am I?
Herod had me, the brother of John, put to death with the sword. Who am I?
When Herod saw that this met with approval among the Jews, whom did he seize next?
This happened during which festival?
After arresting Peter, Herod put him in prison, handing him over to be guarded by how many soldiers?
options: Four squads of four soldiers each

questions.questionText: Herod intended to bring Peter out for public trial after what?
What was the church doing while Peter was in prison?
options: The church was earnestly praying to God for him

questions.questionText: The night before Herod was to bring him to trial, how was Peter sleeping?
options: Between two soldiers, bound with two chains

questions.questionText: Who appeared and struck Peter on the side to wake him?
The angel said, “Quick, get up!” What fell off?
The angel told Peter to do what?
options: Put on your clothes and sandals… Wrap your cloak around you and follow me

questions.questionText: Peter thought he was seeing what?
They passed the first and second guards and came to what gate?
options: The iron gate leading to the city

questions.questionText: When the angel left him, what did Peter say?
options: Now I know without a doubt that the Lord has sent his angel
I must go back to jail

questions.questionText: Where did Peter go when he realized this?
options: The house of Mary the mother of John, also called Mark

questions.questionText: I am a servant named who came to answer the door and was so overjoyed she forgot to open it.
The people told Rhoda, “You’re out of your mind.” Then they said it was what?
What was Peter doing while they argued?
Peter motioned with his hand for them to be quiet and told them to tell whom?
options: James and the other brothers and sisters

questions.questionText: Then Peter left for another place. In the morning, what happened at the prison?
options: There was no small commotion among the soldiers

questions.questionText: After Herod had a thorough search made and did not find Peter, what did he do?
options: He cross-examined the guards and ordered that they be executed
He left for Rome in peace

questions.questionText: Then Herod went from Judea to where and stayed there?
Herod had been quarreling with the people of Tyre and Sidon. Whom did they win over?
options: Blastus, a trusted personal servant of the king

questions.questionText: On the appointed day Herod wore royal robes and sat on his throne. What did the people shout?
options: This is the voice of a god, not of a man

questions.questionText: Why did an angel of the Lord strike Herod down?
options: Because he did not give praise to God

questions.questionText: How did Herod die?
options: He was eaten by worms and died
He fell off a horse only
He slept peacefully to old age in this chapter

questions.questionText: What happened to the word of God?
options: It continued to spread and flourish

questions.questionText: When Barnabas and Saul had finished their mission, they returned from Jerusalem and brought with them whom?
My other name is Mark, and my mother is Mary. Who am I?
True or false: Sentries stood guard at the entrance while Peter slept chained.
options: True — but the door was open

questions.questionText: I opened the iron gate by itself. Who am I working with Peter?
Peter went out and walked along one street, then the angel left him. Then he realized he was free from what?
options: Herod’s clutches and all the Jewish people were hoping would happen

questions.questionText: People at Mary’s house said I must be Peter’s angel. Who did they think was at the door?
Who motioned for them to be quiet and described how the Lord had brought him out of jail?
Herod had Peter imprisoned. Where was the public trial supposed to happen after Passover?
options: He intended a public trial (in that place of his rule)

questions.questionText: True or false: Rhoda recognized Peter’s voice.
options: False — she thought it was Herod
True — and she opened at once

questions.questionText: I am king and I wore royal robes on the appointed day. Who am I?
Why did Tyre and Sidon want peace with Herod?
options: Because they depended on the king’s country for their food supply

questions.questionText: After Herod died, the word of God did what?
Barnabas and Saul brought me from Jerusalem after their mission. Who am I?
How many chains bound Peter?
